stock.description: Sichuan Baicha Baidao Industrial Co., Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise, founded in 2008 and headquartered in Chengdu, People's Republic of China. Operating as a subsidiary of Sichuan Hengsheng Herui Industrial Group Co., Ltd., its core business involves supplying tea beverages throughout the People's Republic of China. The company's operations are multifaceted, extending to robust supply chain management, comprehensive franchise oversight (including marketing campaigns and operational support), and the production of biodegradable straws and packaging. Additionally, it offers IT services and maintenance, provides training for its franchisees, and manages logistics and distribution networks. Its tea drink offerings are retailed through a blend of company-owned and franchised outlets, all branded under the popular ChaPanda name.
